facts.business: Emami Realty Limited is a Kolkata-based real estate developer engaged in the development of real estate property in India.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Heading into FY 2026-27, the Company expects the residential real estate market to remain stable, supported by steady urbanization, rising household incomes, and continued government emphasis on infrastructure and housing-linked policy support.

key_risks: Decrease in borrowings leading to debt equity ratio volatility

Exposure to West Bengal regional market concentration
Regulatory and policy changes in real estate sector
